# Drama League Award for Unique Contribution to the Theatre

}}
The Drama League Award for Unique Contribution to the Theatre is a theater award presented annually since 1982 by The Drama League for "singular achievement by individuals, organizations, or partnerships that have made an indelible impact upon professional theatre in New York City."
